Compare its revenue, cost, profit, quantity sold, and profit margin across the two years, and explain the main factors contributing to the change.

analytical_plan.analytical_objective: Analyze sales data by year and region to determine which region shows the strongest improvement in profitability from 2024 to 2025, and compare revenue, cost, profit, quantity sold, and profit margin across the two years.
analytical_plan.metric_definition: profit = revenue - cost; profit_margin = profit / revenue
analytical_plan.comparison: Comparing metrics across 2024 and 2025 for each region to identify the region with the strongest profitability improvement
analytical_plan.analytical_question: Which region shows the strongest improvement in profitability from 2024 to 2025, and how do revenue, cost, profit, quantity sold, and profit margin compare across the two years for that region?

generated_sql: SELECT year(CAST(sale_date AS DATE)) AS year, region, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(cost) AS cost, (SUM(revenue) - SUM(cost)) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity_sold, (SUM(revenue) - SUM(cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) AS profit_margin FROM data WHERE year(CAST(sale_date AS DATE)) IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY year(CAST(sale_date AS DATE)), region

insights.statement: North region shows the strongest improvement in profitability from 2024 to 2025, with profit increasing from 4380 to 13620 (increase of 9240).

evidence.claim: Profit increase for North from 2024 to 2025 is 9240
